0022600160.text: The Atlanta Hawks (3-4, 2-2 on the road) enter on a one-game losing streak, sitting 7th in the East and 0.5 games behind for 2nd in the Southeast. The Indiana Pacers (2-4, 0-2 at home) have lost three straight and sit 12th in the East, with Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, Obi Toppin, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton all out. For Atlanta, Henri Veesaar and Mouhamed Gueye are out, Jalen Johnson and Jock Landale are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the teams have not met yet this season, though the Hawks won the 2025-26 series 2-1 and last lost to Indiana 129-124 in Indianapolis on January 31.
